1.title: The Tate Brothers Are Losing Right-Wing Allies After Their Arrest
1.summary: After Andrew and Tristan Tate, prominent leaders of the so-called manosphere, were arrested in Miami, many of their onetime allies on the American right pulled back support.

2.title: Vance Boelter Ordered to Spend Life in Prison for Shooting Minnesota Lawmakers
2.summary: Vance Boelter, the Minnesota man who attacked state lawmakers in their homes last year, had pleaded guilty after prosecutors opted not to seek the death penalty.

3.title: House Again Rebukes Trump on Iran War Powers Vote
3.summary: For the second time, a few House Republicans joined Democrats to back a measure calling on the president to seek authorization for the war.

4.title: Iran War Live Updates: Red Sea Turmoil Pushes Oil Past $100 a Barrel
4.summary: The price of Brent crude soared after Iran’s Houthi allies in Yemen claimed strikes on two Saudi tankers. The House cast a second vote to rein in President Trump’s war powers, with four Republicans joining Democrats to rebuke the president.

5.title: ‘We Will All Die From Ebola Here’: Virus Stalks Crowded Camps in Congo
5.summary: There are a million people displaced by violence in the epicenter. They live in dangerous conditions and are fighting the virus with very little clean water.

6.title: Saudis must recognise Israel for nuclear deal, says Trump
6.summary: The US president says the landmark agreement to help Saudis develop nuclear energy is dependent on it joining the Abraham Accords.
